everyday-green-salad.name: Everyday Green Salad
everyday-green-salad.description: Crisp leaves, juicy tomatoes, and a bright lemon dressing. A simple side for almost any table.
ingredients: 100 g butterhead lettuce, washed and dried
steps: Tear the lettuce into bite-size pieces and put it in a large bowl.
Add the tomatoes, cucumber, radishes, and avocado.
Whisk the olive oil, lemon juice, and pepper in a small bowl.
Pour the dressing over the salad. Toss gently and serve straight away.
everyday-green-salad.tip: Keep the leaves and dressing separate until you are ready to eat. Add cooked chickpeas or another protein of your choice for a more substantial meal.

spinach-apple-smoothie.name: Spinach & Apple Smoothie
spinach-apple-smoothie.description: A fresh green blend with apple, banana, and a squeeze of lemon. No complicated ingredients.
steps: Put the water and spinach in a blender. Blend until the leaves are finely broken down.
Add the banana, apple, lemon juice, and ice, if using.
Blend until smooth. Add a little more water if you prefer a thinner drink.
Divide between two glasses and serve immediately.
spinach-apple-smoothie.tip: Use a ripe banana for sweetness. This is a serving idea, not a meal-replacement or detox drink.

roasted-vegetable-bowl.name: Roasted Vegetable Bowl
roasted-vegetable-bowl.description: Colourful roasted vegetables and chickpeas over brown rice. Warm, simple, and easy to make your own.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Line a large baking tray.
Toss the pepper, courgette, broccoli, tomatoes, and chickpeas with the oil and cumin. Spread them in a single layer.
Roast for 20–25 minutes, turning once, until the vegetables are tender and lightly browned.
Heat the cooked rice according to its pack instructions. Divide it between two bowls.
Add the roasted vegetables and chickpeas. Finish with lemon juice and parsley.
roasted-vegetable-bowl.tip: Use a large tray so the vegetables roast evenly. Use freshly cooked rice or follow the storage and reheating instructions on the rice pack.

fresh-basil-pasta.name: Fresh Basil Pasta
fresh-basil-pasta.description: Basil, lemon, and pumpkin seeds make a lively pesto for a quick bowl of tomato pasta.
ingredients: 30 g fresh basil leaves, washed and dried
steps: Cook the spaghetti in boiling water according to its pack instructions. Save a mug of the cooking water before draining.
Blend the basil, pumpkin seeds, garlic, olive oil, and lemon juice into a coarse pesto.
Put the warm pasta back in the pan, off the heat. Add the pesto and tomatoes.
Toss with a splash of the reserved cooking water until the sauce coats the pasta. Add pepper and serve.
fresh-basil-pasta.tip: Keep a few basil leaves to scatter over the bowl. Check the pasta label for allergens and use a suitable alternative if needed.

Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Pour in the stock.

Remove from the heat. Blend with an immersion blender, keeping the blade submerged. Season with pepper and serve.

lemon-garlic-chicken-carrot-beans.name: Lemon Garlic Chicken Carrot Beans

ingredients: 350 g boneless chicken thigh, cut into 2 cm pieces
200 g carrots, cut into thin batons
150 g green beans, trimmed and halved
steps: Wash and prepare the vegetables and herbs. Keep the raw protein and its utensils separate from the fresh produce.
Heat the oil in a wide pan. Add the garlic and stir for 1 minute.
Add the carrot batons, green beans. Cook for 8–10 minutes, until tender. Move the vegetables to a plate.
Add the chicken to the pan. Add the black pepper and salt. Cook for 12–16 minutes, turning the pieces. Continue cooking if needed.
Check the thickest chicken piece with a food thermometer. It must reach 74°C.
Add the lemon juice just before serving.
Add the parsley before serving.
Taste before adding more salt. Serve hot.
lemon-garlic-chicken-carrot-beans.tip: Use a food thermometer to check the chicken. Cooking times can change with piece size.

Add the chicken. Simmer for 15–20 minutes. Continue cooking if needed.
Check the thickest chicken piece with a food thermometer. It must reach 74°C.
Add the coriander before serving.
Taste before adding more salt. Serve hot.
chicken-spinach-tomato-curry.tip: Use a food thermometer to check the chicken. Cooking times can change with piece size.

Cook until the egg mixture reaches 71°C and no liquid egg remains.
Add the cooked noodles to the pan. Toss gently, or divide the noodles into bowls and ladle the broth over them.
Taste before adding more salt. Serve hot.
egg-napa-carrot-noodles.tip: Use fresh eggs. Cook both the yolks and whites until firm.

egg-green-bean-tomato-skillet.name: Egg Green Bean Tomato Skillet
egg-green-bean-tomato-skillet.description: Eggs with green beans and plum tomatoes, served as eggs set in a vegetable skillet with toasted cumin.
ingredients: 150 g green beans, trimmed and halved
steps: Wash and prepare the vegetables and herbs. Keep the raw protein and its utensils separate from the fresh produce.
Heat the oil in a pan. Add the garlic. Stir for 1 minute.
Add the green beans, tomatoes. Cook for 8–10 minutes, until tender. Add the cumin and black pepper and salt.
Make four spaces in the vegetables. Break an egg into each space. Cover and cook on low heat for 6–10 minutes, until the whites and yolks are firm.
Cook until the egg mixture reaches 71°C and no liquid egg remains.
Add the parsley before serving.
Taste before adding more salt. Serve hot.
egg-green-bean-tomato-skillet.tip: Use fresh eggs. Cook both the yolks and whites until firm.

egg-beetroot-mint-salad.name: Egg Beetroot Mint Salad
egg-beetroot-mint-salad.description: Eggs with cooked beetroot and cucumber, served as a boiled egg salad with plain yoghurt and cumin.
ingredients: 150 g cooked beetroot, cooled and diced
steps: Wash and prepare the vegetables and herbs. Keep the raw protein and its utensils separate from the fresh produce.

While you prepare the vegetables, put the eggs in a saucepan and cover with cold water. Bring to a boil and simmer for 10–12 minutes, until the yolks and whites are firm. Cool in cold water, peel and halve.
Mix the oil, garlic, salt and yoghurt and cumin in a bowl. Toss the cooked beetroot, cucumber in the dressing.
Put the dressed vegetables on plates and top with the halved boiled eggs.
Add the mint before serving.
Serve the salad as soon as it is assembled.
egg-beetroot-mint-salad.tip: Use fresh eggs. Cook both the yolks and whites until firm.

banana-flour-yoghurt-pancakes.name: Banana flour yoghurt pancakes
banana-flour-yoghurt-pancakes.description: Small, soft pancakes made with a blend of banana flour, wheat flour and yoghurt.
ingredients: 80 g plain yoghurt, plus 4 tbsp to serve
steps: Mix the banana flour, wheat flour, baking powder and sugar in a bowl.
Whisk in the yoghurt, milk and 1 tsp oil until no dry flour remains. Rest for 5 minutes.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium-low heat. Brush it with the remaining oil.
Spoon in small rounds of batter. Cook for 2–3 minutes, until the edges set and bubbles appear.
Turn each pancake and cook for another 1–2 minutes, until the centre is set. Repeat with the remaining batter.
Serve warm with the extra yoghurt and sliced banana.
banana-flour-yoghurt-pancakes.tip: Banana flour absorbs liquid. Add milk 1 tbsp at a time if the rested batter is too thick to spoon.

banana-flour-cumin-flatbreads.name: Banana flour cumin flatbreads
banana-flour-cumin-flatbreads.description: A wheat and banana flour blend makes these small cumin flatbreads easy to serve with yoghurt.
ingredients: 100 ml warm water, plus a little if needed
steps: Mix both flours, the cumin and salt. Add the water and 1 tsp oil.
Knead for 4–5 minutes to make a soft dough. Add water 1 tsp at a time if it cracks.
Cover the dough and rest for 10 minutes. Divide it into four equal pieces.
Roll each piece into a thin round on a lightly floured surface.
Cook on a hot dry skillet for about 1 minute on each side. Brush lightly with the remaining oil and turn again until brown spots appear.
Keep the cooked breads wrapped in a clean cloth. Serve with yoghurt.
banana-flour-cumin-flatbreads.tip: Roll small breads rather than large ones; the flour blend is easier to handle this way.

banana-flour-savoury-waffles.name: Banana flour savoury waffles
banana-flour-savoury-waffles.description: Crisp-edged savoury waffles with spring onion and a wheat–banana flour blend.
ingredients: 100 g plain yoghurt, plus 4 tbsp to serve
1 tbsp neutral oil, plus a little for the waffle iron
steps: Preheat the waffle iron according to its instructions.
Mix both flours, the baking powder and salt. Whisk in the yoghurt, milk and oil.
Fold in the spring onion and rest the batter for 5 minutes.
Lightly oil the waffle plates. Add the amount of batter recommended for the iron.
Cook until the waffles are golden, release easily and have a set centre, usually 4–6 minutes per batch.
Place cooked waffles on a rack so they stay crisp. Serve with yoghurt.
banana-flour-savoury-waffles.tip: Keep the first batch warm in a 100°C oven while you cook the rest.

banana-flour-cardamom-muffins.name: Banana flour cardamom muffins
banana-flour-cardamom-muffins.description: Small yoghurt muffins with banana flour, wheat flour and a light cardamom flavour.
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C. Line six muffin cups with paper cases.
Mix the flours, baking powder, cardamom, sugar and salt.
Whisk the yoghurt, milk and oil in a second bowl.
Fold the wet mixture into the dry ingredients until no dry flour remains. Divide among the six cups.
Bake for 20–22 minutes, until the tops spring back and a skewer comes out without wet batter.
Cool in the tin for 5 minutes, then transfer to a rack.
banana-flour-cardamom-muffins.tip: Mix only until combined. Extra mixing can make the crumb firm.

moringa-besan-chilla.name: Moringa besan chilla
moringa-besan-chilla.description: Thin chickpea-flour pancakes with moringa leaf powder, onion and coriander.
steps: Mix the besan, moringa powder, cumin and salt.
Whisk in the water to make a smooth, pourable batter. Stir in the onion and coriander.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat and brush it with a little oil.
Spread a small ladle of batter into a thin round. Cook for 2–3 minutes, until the top looks set.
Turn and cook for 1–2 minutes, until cooked through. Repeat with the remaining batter and oil.
Serve warm with yoghurt.
moringa-besan-chilla.tip: Add water 1 tbsp at a time if the batter thickens as it stands.

moringa-lemon-lentil-soup.name: Moringa lemon lentil soup
moringa-lemon-lentil-soup.description: A thick split-lentil soup finished with moringa leaf powder and lemon.
ingredients: 100 g yellow split lentils (moong dal), rinsed
steps: Heat the oil in a saucepan. Add the cumin and stir for 30 seconds.
Add the onion and cook for 4 minutes, until softened.
Add the lentils and water. Bring to a boil, then simmer for 18–22 minutes, until the lentils are soft.
Mix the moringa powder with 2 tbsp of the hot soup. Stir it back into the pan with the salt.
Simmer for 2 minutes. Add a little water if the soup is too thick.
Remove from the heat and stir in the lemon juice and coriander.
moringa-lemon-lentil-soup.tip: Use a whisk to break down the soft lentils if you prefer a smoother soup.

moringa-pea-pulao.name: Moringa pea pulao
moringa-pea-pulao.description: Basmati rice and peas with a small amount of moringa powder and cumin.
ingredients: 150 g basmati rice, rinsed and drained
steps: Heat the oil in a saucepan with a tight-fitting lid. Add the cumin and stir for 30 seconds.
Add the drained rice and stir gently for 1 minute.
Mix the moringa powder with the water. Add it to the rice with the peas and salt.
Bring to a boil, cover and reduce the heat to low. Cook for 12 minutes.
Turn off the heat and leave the pan covered for 5 minutes. Check that the rice is tender.
Fluff with a fork and add the lemon juice.
moringa-pea-pulao.tip: Use the rice pack’s water ratio if it differs from this recipe.

moringa-sesame-roti.name: Moringa sesame roti
moringa-sesame-roti.description: Whole-wheat rotis with moringa leaf powder and sesame seeds.
ingredients: 160 g whole-wheat flour, plus a little for rolling
105 ml warm water, plus a little if needed
steps: Mix the flour, moringa powder, sesame seeds and salt.
Add the water and 1 tsp oil. Knead for 4–5 minutes, until soft and smooth.
Cover and rest for 10 minutes. Divide into four equal balls.
Roll each ball into a thin round on a lightly floured surface.
Cook on a hot skillet for about 1 minute per side. Brush with the remaining oil and turn until brown spots appear.
Keep warm in a clean cloth and serve with yoghurt.
moringa-sesame-roti.tip: Begin with the listed amount of moringa powder; its earthy flavour becomes stronger as you add more.

beetroot-powder-hummus.name: Beetroot powder hummus
beetroot-powder-hummus.description: Chickpea hummus coloured and flavoured with beetroot powder.
ingredients: 1 tbsp olive oil, plus 1 tsp to finish
3 tbsp water, plus a little if needed
steps: Mix the beetroot powder with the water in a small bowl until smooth.
Put the chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, olive oil, garlic and salt in a food processor.
Add the beetroot mixture and blend until smooth, scraping down the bowl as needed.
Add water 1 tbsp at a time to reach a soft, spreadable texture.
Spoon into a shallow bowl. Finish with the extra olive oil and parsley.
beetroot-powder-hummus.tip: Use cooked, cooled chickpeas. Keep the finished dip covered in the fridge and use within 2 days.

beetroot-cumin-paratha.name: Beetroot cumin paratha
beetroot-cumin-paratha.description: Whole-wheat parathas with beetroot powder and cumin.
ingredients: 160 g whole-wheat flour, plus a little for rolling
105 ml warm water, plus a little if needed
steps: Mix the flour, beetroot powder, cumin and salt.
Add the water and 1 tsp oil. Knead into a soft dough, adding a little water if needed.
Cover and rest for 10 minutes. Divide into four balls.
Roll each ball into a thin round on a lightly floured surface.
Cook each bread on a hot skillet for 1 minute per side. Add a little of the remaining oil and cook until brown spots appear and the centre is cooked.
Serve warm with yoghurt.
beetroot-cumin-paratha.tip: Beetroot powder can stain the work surface. Roll on a washable board.

beetroot-coconut-rice.name: Beetroot coconut rice
beetroot-coconut-rice.description: Pink rice with beetroot powder, grated coconut and curry leaves.
ingredients: 150 g basmati rice, rinsed and drained
steps: Heat the oil in a saucepan. Add the mustard seeds and let them begin to pop.
Add the curry leaves carefully, then stir in the drained rice.
Mix the beetroot powder with the water. Add this mixture and the salt to the pan.
Bring to a boil. Cover and cook over low heat for 12 minutes.
Turn off the heat and rest, covered, for 5 minutes. Check that the rice is tender.
Fluff gently and fold in the grated coconut.
beetroot-coconut-rice.tip: Add the coconut at the end to keep its texture.

beetroot-cocoa-pancakes.name: Beetroot cocoa pancakes
beetroot-cocoa-pancakes.description: Cocoa pancakes with beetroot powder, served with yoghurt and banana.
ingredients: 100 g plain yoghurt, plus 4 tbsp to serve
steps: Mix the flour, beetroot powder, cocoa, baking powder and sugar.
Whisk in the yoghurt, milk and 1 tsp oil. Rest the batter for 5 minutes.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium-low heat. Brush with the remaining oil.
Spoon small rounds of batter into the pan. Cook for 2–3 minutes, until the edges set.
Turn and cook for another 1–2 minutes, until there is no wet batter in the centre. Repeat with the remaining batter.
Serve with yoghurt and sliced banana.
beetroot-cocoa-pancakes.tip: Cocoa makes the cooked colour darker. Do not expect bright pink pancakes.

turmeric-lemon-chickpeas.name: Turmeric lemon chickpeas
turmeric-lemon-chickpeas.description: Warm chickpeas with turmeric, cumin and lemon.
steps: Pat the drained chickpeas dry.
Heat the oil in a wide pan over medium heat. Add the turmeric and cumin and stir for 20 seconds.
Add the chickpeas, water and salt. Stir to coat.
Cover and cook for 5 minutes. Uncover and cook for another 4–5 minutes, until hot and lightly coated.
Remove from the heat. Add the lemon juice and parsley, then serve.
turmeric-lemon-chickpeas.tip: Add a little water if the spices begin to catch on the pan.

turmeric-coconut-dal.name: Turmeric coconut dal
turmeric-coconut-dal.description: Yellow split lentils simmered with turmeric and coconut milk.
ingredients: 120 g yellow split lentils (moong dal), rinsed
steps: Put the lentils, turmeric and water in a saucepan. Bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat and simmer for 18–22 minutes, until the lentils are soft. Stir occasionally.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a small pan. Add the cumin, then the onion. Cook for 5–6 minutes, until softened.
Stir the onion mixture, coconut milk and salt into the lentils.
Simmer for 3 minutes. Add a little water if needed and finish with coriander.
turmeric-coconut-dal.tip: Keep the final simmer gentle after adding coconut milk.

turmeric-cauliflower-tray-bake.name: Turmeric cauliflower tray bake
turmeric-cauliflower-tray-bake.description: Roasted cauliflower and chickpeas with turmeric and cumin.
ingredients: 240 g cooked chickpeas, drained and dried
steps: Heat the oven to 210°C. Line a large tray with baking paper.
Mix the oil, turmeric, cumin and salt in a large bowl.
Add the cauliflower and chickpeas. Toss until evenly coated.
Spread in one layer on the tray. Roast for 22–25 minutes, turning once, until the cauliflower is tender with browned edges.
Add the lemon juice and coriander before serving.
turmeric-cauliflower-tray-bake.tip: Use a large tray. Crowded florets steam instead of browning.

turmeric-pea-upma.name: Turmeric pea upma
turmeric-pea-upma.description: Semolina upma with peas, turmeric and curry leaves.
steps: Dry-toast the semolina in a saucepan over medium-low heat for 3–4 minutes. Transfer to a plate.
Heat the oil in the pan. Add the mustard seeds and let them begin to pop. Add the curry leaves and onion. Cook for 3 minutes.
Add the turmeric, peas, hot water and salt. Bring to a gentle boil.
Lower the heat. Pour in the semolina slowly while stirring to avoid lumps.
Cover and cook for 3 minutes. Turn off the heat and rest for 2 minutes.
Fluff gently and stir in the lemon juice.
turmeric-pea-upma.tip: Pour slowly and stir continuously when you add the semolina.

onion-powder-potato-wedges.name: Onion powder potato wedges
onion-powder-potato-wedges.description: Oven-baked potato wedges seasoned with onion powder and paprika.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C. Line a large baking tray.
Cut the potatoes into even wedges and pat them dry.
Mix the onion powder, paprika, oil, salt and pepper. Toss with the wedges.
Spread the wedges in one layer. Roast for 28–30 minutes, turning halfway, until tender inside and browned outside.
Scatter with parsley and serve with yoghurt.
onion-powder-potato-wedges.tip: Leave space between the wedges so the edges can brown.

onion-powder-lentil-patties.name: Onion powder lentil patties
onion-powder-lentil-patties.description: Pan-seared cooked lentil patties with onion powder and coriander.
ingredients: 250 g cooked red lentils, cooled and well drained
steps: Mash the drained lentils in a bowl.
Mix in the breadcrumbs, onion powder, cumin, coriander, lemon juice and salt. Rest for 5 minutes.
Shape into six small patties. If the mixture is wet, add breadcrumbs 1 tbsp at a time.
Heat the oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat. Cook the patties for 4–5 minutes on each side, until browned and hot throughout.
Serve with yoghurt.
onion-powder-lentil-patties.tip: Cool and drain the lentils before mixing; extra water makes the patties difficult to turn.

onion-powder-creamy-polenta.name: Onion powder creamy polenta
onion-powder-creamy-polenta.description: Soft polenta with onion powder and sautéed mushrooms.
steps: Bring the water, milk, onion powder and salt to a gentle simmer in a saucepan.
Pour in the polenta slowly while whisking. Reduce the heat to low.
Cook for 20–25 minutes, stirring often, until smooth and tender. Follow the pack timing if it differs.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a skillet. Cook the mushrooms for 6–8 minutes, until browned.
Stir the butter into the polenta. Serve with the mushrooms, black pepper and chives.
onion-powder-creamy-polenta.tip: Add hot water 1 tbsp at a time if the polenta becomes too firm.

onion-powder-butter-beans.name: Onion powder butter beans
onion-powder-butter-beans.description: Butter beans simmered with carrot, onion powder and parsley.
steps: Heat the oil in a saucepan. Add the carrot and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir the onion powder into the water, then add it to the pan.
Add the beans, salt and pepper. Bring to a simmer.
Cook for 12–15 minutes, until the carrot is tender. Mash a few beans against the side of the pan to thicken the sauce.
Remove from the heat and add the lemon juice and parsley.
onion-powder-butter-beans.tip: Add water in small amounts if the beans become too dry during cooking.

onion-flake-rice-pilaf.name: Onion flake rice pilaf
onion-flake-rice-pilaf.description: Basmati rice with softened onion flakes, peas and cumin.
ingredients: 150 g basmati rice, rinsed and drained
steps: Soak the onion flakes in the measured water for 5 minutes. Keep the soaking water.
Heat the oil in a saucepan. Add the cumin and stir for 30 seconds.
Add the drained rice and stir for 1 minute. Add the onion flakes with their water, peas and salt.
Bring to a boil. Cover and cook on low heat for 12 minutes.
Turn off the heat and rest, covered, for 5 minutes. Check that the rice is tender, then fluff and add coriander.
onion-flake-rice-pilaf.tip: The onion flakes need liquid to soften; do not discard their soaking water.

onion-flake-roast-potatoes.name: Onion flake roast potatoes
onion-flake-roast-potatoes.description: Roast potato cubes finished with softened onion flakes and rosemary.
ingredients: 500 g potatoes, scrubbed and cut into 2 cm cubes
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C. Line a baking tray.
Toss the potato cubes with the oil, rosemary, salt and pepper. Spread in one layer.
Roast for 20 minutes, turning once.
Meanwhile, soak the onion flakes in the warm water for 10 minutes. Drain any remaining water.
Scatter the softened flakes over the potatoes. Turn gently and roast for 8–10 minutes more, until the potatoes are tender and the flakes are golden.
onion-flake-roast-potatoes.tip: Add the onion flakes near the end so they do not burn.

onion-flake-tomato-dal.name: Onion flake tomato dal
onion-flake-tomato-dal.description: Red lentils with onion flakes, tomato and cumin.
steps: Heat the oil in a saucepan. Add the cumin and stir for 30 seconds.
Add the chopped tomatoes and turmeric. Cook for 4 minutes.
Add the lentils, onion flakes and water. Bring to a boil.
Simmer for 18–22 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the lentils and onion flakes are soft.
Add the salt and a little water if needed. Finish with coriander.
onion-flake-tomato-dal.tip: The flakes soften directly in the dal, so no separate soaking is needed.

spinach-powder-green-pasta.name: Spinach powder green pasta
spinach-powder-green-pasta.description: Hand-cut wheat pasta with spinach powder, tossed with butter and garlic.
ingredients: 200 g plain wheat flour, plus a little for rolling
95 ml water, plus a little if needed
½ tsp salt for the cooking water
steps: Mix the flour and spinach powder. Add the water and oil, then knead for 6–8 minutes into a firm, smooth dough. Add water 1 tsp at a time only if needed.
Cover and rest for 20 minutes.
Roll thinly on a floured surface, about 1–2 mm thick. Dust lightly, fold loosely and cut into strips. Unfold the strips.
Bring a large pan of water to a boil and add the salt. Cook the pasta for 3–5 minutes, until tender. Reserve 4 tbsp cooking water before draining.
Melt the butter in a skillet. Cook the garlic for 30 seconds without browning.
Toss in the pasta with 2–4 tbsp cooking water. Add the pepper and cheese, then serve.
spinach-powder-green-pasta.tip: Roll the dough evenly so all the pasta strips cook at the same rate.

spinach-powder-paneer-paratha.name: Spinach powder paneer paratha
spinach-powder-paneer-paratha.description: Green wheat parathas filled with crumbled paneer and cumin.
ingredients: 160 g whole-wheat flour, plus a little for rolling
105 ml warm water, plus a little if needed
steps: Mix the flour and spinach powder. Add the water and knead into a soft dough. Cover and rest for 10 minutes.
Mix the paneer with the cumin, coriander and salt. Divide the filling into four portions.
Divide the dough into four balls. Flatten one, place a filling portion in the centre and pinch the edges closed.
Roll gently into a small round. Repeat with the remaining dough and filling.
Cook on a hot skillet for about 1 minute per side. Brush with oil and turn until browned and hot through the centre.
Serve warm with yoghurt.
spinach-powder-paneer-paratha.tip: Keep the filling dry and roll gently to reduce tearing.

spinach-powder-potato-soup.name: Spinach powder potato soup
spinach-powder-potato-soup.description: A smooth potato soup finished with spinach powder and milk.
steps: Heat the oil in a saucepan. Add the onion and cook for 4 minutes.
Add the potatoes and water. Bring to a boil, then simmer for 15–18 minutes, until the potatoes are soft.
Remove from the heat. Blend carefully with a stick blender until smooth.
Mix the spinach powder with the milk. Stir into the soup with the salt and pepper.
Return to low heat and simmer for 3 minutes. Serve with toasted bread.
spinach-powder-potato-soup.tip: Add water to loosen the soup after blending if needed.

spinach-powder-savoury-crepes.name: Spinach powder savoury crepes
spinach-powder-savoury-crepes.description: Thin spinach-powder crepes filled with mushrooms and paneer.
ingredients: 2 tsp neutral oil, plus 1 tsp for the filling
steps: Whisk the flour, spinach powder, milk, half the salt and 1 tsp oil into a smooth batter. Rest for 10 minutes.
Heat 1 tsp oil in a skillet. Cook the mushrooms for 6–8 minutes, until browned. Add the paneer and pepper and cook for 2 minutes.
Heat a non-stick crepe pan over medium heat. Brush lightly with the remaining oil.
Pour in a small ladle of batter and swirl into a thin layer. Cook for 1–2 minutes, until set, then turn and cook for 30–60 seconds.
Repeat with the remaining batter. Divide the filling among the crepes and fold to serve.
spinach-powder-savoury-crepes.tip: If the batter will not spread thinly, add milk 1 tbsp at a time.

carrot-powder-cumin-rice.name: Carrot powder cumin rice
carrot-powder-cumin-rice.description: Basmati rice with carrot powder, cumin and peas.
ingredients: 150 g basmati rice, rinsed and drained
steps: Heat the oil in a saucepan with a lid. Add the cumin and stir for 30 seconds.
Add the drained rice and stir gently for 1 minute.
Mix the carrot powder with the water. Add it to the pan with the peas and salt.
Bring to a boil. Cover and cook over low heat for 12 minutes.
Turn off the heat and rest for 5 minutes. Check that the rice is tender, then fluff and add coriander.
carrot-powder-cumin-rice.tip: Use the rice pack’s water ratio if it differs, allowing a little extra liquid for the powder.

carrot-powder-ginger-soup.name: Carrot powder ginger soup
carrot-powder-ginger-soup.description: A smooth potato-based soup with carrot powder and ginger.
steps: Heat the oil in a saucepan. Cook the onion for 4 minutes, then add the ginger and stir for 30 seconds.
Add the potatoes and water. Bring to a boil, then simmer for 15–18 minutes, until soft.
Mix the carrot powder with 3 tbsp of the hot liquid. Stir it back into the soup.
Remove from the heat and blend carefully with a stick blender.
Return to low heat for 2 minutes. Add the salt and pepper, then serve with a small yoghurt swirl.
carrot-powder-ginger-soup.tip: Mix the powder into liquid before blending to avoid dry clumps.

carrot-powder-oat-pancakes.name: Carrot powder oat pancakes
carrot-powder-oat-pancakes.description: Soft oat pancakes with carrot powder, yoghurt and walnuts.
ingredients: 100 g plain yoghurt, plus 4 tbsp to serve
steps: Mix the ground oats, wheat flour, carrot powder, baking powder and sugar.
Whisk in the yoghurt, milk and 1 tsp oil. Rest for 5 minutes.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium-low heat. Brush with the remaining oil.
Cook small rounds of batter for 2–3 minutes, until the edges set. Turn and cook for 1–2 minutes, until the centres are cooked.
Repeat with the remaining batter. Serve with yoghurt and walnuts.
carrot-powder-oat-pancakes.tip: Oats thicken the batter as it stands. Loosen with milk 1 tbsp at a time.

tomato-powder-pasta-sauce.name: Tomato powder pasta sauce
tomato-powder-pasta-sauce.description: A cooked tomato-powder sauce for penne, finished with basil.
steps: Mix the tomato powder with the warm water until smooth.
Heat the oil in a saucepan. Cook the garlic for 30 seconds without browning.
Add the tomato mixture, oregano, salt and pepper. Simmer gently for 12–15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Meanwhile, cook the penne according to its pack instructions. Reserve 4 tbsp cooking water, then drain.
Toss the pasta with the sauce. Add cooking water a little at a time if needed.
Finish with the basil and cheese.
tomato-powder-pasta-sauce.tip: Tomato powders differ in strength. Taste the cooked sauce before adding more seasoning.

tomato-powder-chickpea-stew.name: Tomato powder chickpea stew
tomato-powder-chickpea-stew.description: Chickpeas and carrots simmered in a tomato-powder sauce.
steps: Mix the tomato powder with the warm water.
Heat the oil in a saucepan. Cook the onion and carrot for 5 minutes.
Add the cumin and stir for 20 seconds. Add the chickpeas, tomato mixture and salt.
Bring to a simmer and cook for 18–20 minutes, until the carrots are tender. Stir occasionally.
Add a little water if needed and finish with coriander.
tomato-powder-chickpea-stew.tip: Mash a few chickpeas into the sauce if you prefer a thicker stew.

tomato-powder-spiced-rice.name: Tomato powder spiced rice
tomato-powder-spiced-rice.description: Basmati rice with tomato powder, peas and cumin.
ingredients: 150 g basmati rice, rinsed and drained
steps: Mix the tomato powder with the warm water until smooth.
Heat the oil in a saucepan. Add the cumin and stir for 30 seconds.
Add the rice and cinnamon. Stir gently for 1 minute.
Add the tomato mixture, peas and salt. Bring to a boil, cover and cook on low heat for 12 minutes.
Turn off the heat and rest for 5 minutes. Check that the rice is tender.
Fluff gently, then add the lemon juice and coriander.
tomato-powder-spiced-rice.tip: Keep the heat low once covered; tomato mixtures can catch on the pan.

tomato-powder-lentil-soup.name: Tomato powder lentil soup
tomato-powder-lentil-soup.description: Red lentils and carrots in a tomato-powder soup.
steps: Mix the tomato powder with 150 ml of the measured warm water.
Heat the oil in a saucepan. Cook the onion and carrot for 5 minutes.
Add the lentils, tomato mixture and remaining water. Bring to a boil.
Simmer for 18–22 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the lentils and carrots are soft.
Add the salt and pepper. Loosen with a little water if needed and finish with basil.
tomato-powder-lentil-soup.tip: Leave the soup chunky or blend a portion to make it smoother.

ginger-powder-pear-porridge.name: Ginger powder pear porridge
ginger-powder-pear-porridge.description: Warm oat porridge with cooked pear and ginger powder.
ingredients: 1 ripe pear, cored and thinly sliced
steps: Put the oats, milk, water, ginger and salt in a saucepan.
Add half the pear slices and bring to a gentle simmer.
Cook over low heat for 8–10 minutes, stirring often, until the oats and pear are tender.
Add the remaining pear for the last 2 minutes. Stir in the optional sugar if using.
Divide between two bowls and finish with walnuts.
ginger-powder-pear-porridge.tip: Use the oat pack’s cooking time if it differs from the listed time.

ginger-powder-coconut-chickpeas.name: Ginger powder coconut chickpeas
ginger-powder-coconut-chickpeas.description: Chickpeas in a light coconut sauce with ginger powder and lime.
steps: Heat the oil in a saucepan. Cook the onion for 5 minutes, until softened.
Stir in the cumin and ginger powder for 20 seconds.
Add the chickpeas, coconut milk, water and salt. Bring to a gentle simmer.
Cook for 10–12 minutes, stirring occasionally, until hot and lightly thickened.
Remove from the heat and add the lime juice and coriander.
ginger-powder-coconut-chickpeas.tip: Do not let the dry spices sit in the hot oil for long; add the liquid promptly.

ginger-powder-sesame-tofu.name: Ginger powder sesame tofu
ginger-powder-sesame-tofu.description: Pan-seared tofu with a ginger-soy glaze and sesame seeds.
ingredients: 300 g firm tofu, drained and patted dry
steps: Cut the dry tofu into 2 cm cubes.
Mix the ginger powder, soy sauce, water, sugar and cornflour in a small bowl.
Heat the oil in a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the tofu for 8–10 minutes, turning gently, until golden on several sides.
Stir the sauce again, then pour it into the pan. Reduce the heat and cook for 1–2 minutes, until the glaze thickens and coats the tofu.
Finish with sesame seeds and spring onion.
ginger-powder-sesame-tofu.tip: Pat the tofu dry before frying to reduce splashing and improve browning.

garlic-powder-yoghurt-dip.name: Garlic powder yoghurt dip
garlic-powder-yoghurt-dip.description: A cool yoghurt dip with garlic powder, dill and lemon.
steps: Stir the garlic powder and lemon juice into the yoghurt until smooth.
Mix in the dill, olive oil, pepper and salt.
Let the dip stand in the fridge for 5 minutes so the garlic powder can hydrate.
Stir again and spoon into a small bowl.
Serve with the cucumber batons and flatbread wedges.
garlic-powder-yoghurt-dip.tip: Keep covered in the fridge and use within 2 days.

garlic-powder-roasted-chickpeas.name: Garlic powder roasted chickpeas
garlic-powder-roasted-chickpeas.description: Crisp roasted chickpeas with garlic powder and paprika.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Line a large tray with baking paper.
Pat the chickpeas very dry with a clean cloth or kitchen paper.
Toss with the oil, garlic powder, paprika, salt and pepper.
Spread in one layer and roast for 25–30 minutes, shaking the tray twice, until dry and crisp on the outside.
Cool for 5 minutes on the tray before serving.
garlic-powder-roasted-chickpeas.tip: Serve soon after roasting for the crispest texture.

garlic-powder-herb-flatbreads.name: Garlic powder herb flatbreads
garlic-powder-herb-flatbreads.description: Skillet yoghurt flatbreads brushed with garlic-powder butter and parsley.
ingredients: 160 g plain wheat flour, plus a little for rolling
2 tbsp water, plus a little if needed
steps: Mix the flour, baking powder and salt. Add the yoghurt and water, then knead into a soft dough.
Cover and rest for 10 minutes. Divide into four equal pieces.
Roll each piece into a small round on a lightly floured surface.
Cook on a hot dry skillet for 2–3 minutes per side, until browned and cooked through.
Melt the butter over low heat. Remove from the heat and stir in the garlic powder and parsley.
Brush the warm breads with the garlic butter and serve.
garlic-powder-herb-flatbreads.tip: Add the garlic powder after taking the butter off the heat so it does not scorch.
